user.title: Connect your Iotics account
user.description: First copy your private iotics_app_profile.json to the Home Assistant configuration folder. Sign in with your existing Iotics app account. This is an unofficial integration.

error.missing_profile: The private iotics_app_profile.json file is missing or invalid. Copy it into your Home Assistant configuration folder and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Iotics rejected the login. Check your credentials and account verification in the Iotics app.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve your Iotics devices. Check the internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Iotics account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same Iotics account as before.
